brief:
REFORM Foundation signed agreements to implement 17 community initiatives under the "Partnerships for Resilience" project, the Maan Wire reported. The agreements, finalized in Ramallah, aim to strengthen Palestinian communities through coordinated local action.

The foundation did not specify which communities would benefit from the initiatives or the timeline for implementation. The project represents an expansion of REFORM's community-based programming across Palestinian areas.
title: REFORM Foundation launches 17 community initiatives for Palestinian resilience
